About the Fellowship

The Chicago Fellows programme supports postdoctoral research across the Biological Sciences Division. Applicants identify a faculty mentor and develop a research plan for the fellowship. The Winter 2027 cycle is advertised as open, but the closing date needs confirmation through the application guidance.

Research Areas

  • Biological sciences
  • Biomedical research
  • Postdoctoral research

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPostdoctoral fellowship
Stipend / salaryUSD 70,000/year plus USD 10,000 annual research budget
DurationTwo years

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Academic preparationPhD and/or MD by the start of the fellowship; degree or clinical training recency rules apply.
Further conditionsPhD/MD required and Chicago faculty mentor; degree-recency rules apply.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusWinter 2027 cycle open; deadline to confirm
Deadline / consideration roundNot stated on checked official programme page
LocationUnited States

About University of Chicago

Chicago's Biological Sciences Division hosts the Chicago Fellows postdoctoral programme. Fellows conduct research with a faculty mentor in the division and receive support under the programme's appointment conditions.
